ownership.quote: Benjamin Boyce says he spent $200 on computer use in five days. His first response was frustration. His next response was to start building another option.

stage.quote: Prelaunch · no inventory offered for purchase
stage.note: No funding, accelerator, or investor information found anywhere on the site. Site describes a solo/small founder (Benjamin Boyce) buying literal ThinkCentre desktops and a 'become a host' program splitting revenue with individual hardware hosts. Product is prelaunch: /api/v1/stock shows available 0, purchases_enabled false, no live payments. Treated as bootstrapped rather than unknown given explicit founder origin story and self-funded hardware narrative, but this is an inference, not a confirmed statement of no external funding.

note: Very early-stage, prelaunch, apparently solo-founder (Benjamin Boyce) hobby-to-startup project renting individual ThinkCentre desktop PCs (via Proxmox) to AI agents; also recruiting third-party hardware 'hosts' for a 50% revenue share. No inventory, no live payments, no funding/accelerator/investor information found. Buyers should treat this as unproven, single-point-of-failure infrastructure with no financial backing visible.
